# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Only the latest release receives security fixes.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not open a public issue for security problems. Report privately via either:

- GitHub private vulnerability reporting: the "Report a vulnerability" button on the repository's Security tab.
- Email: josh@jwowk.net

Include the affected version, a description of the issue, and steps to reproduce. You can expect an initial response within a few days.
